meaning.en: (plural "sawteeth") A cutting bit of a saw.
meaning.vi: (""sawteeth"" số nhiều) Một nhát cắt của một cái cưa.

sentences.en: The knife-blade was dull; it cut only because it was chipped in enough places for it to be saw-toothed, jagged.

sentences.en: Looking back, Susan saw South Park filled nearly to the brim with cloud, only the saw-toothed peaks rising above it.

sentences.en: An output sawtooth thereby is produced having one endpoint determined by a fixed voltage source and the other endpoint in accord with the capacitance ratio of the timing and switched capacitors.
